meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把演示主题或现成网页变成可点击跳转的分支幻灯片,自带讲者备注
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要做一份能点击跳转、带讲者备注的演示,而普通幻灯片不够用
copy.tagline_en: Turn a topic or web page into a branching clickable deck with speaker notes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a clickable deck with speaker notes that plain slides can't deliver

howto.what: Claude 会制作 HyperFrames 幻灯片:离散幻灯片、片段揭示、分支与热点导航,带演示者模式和演讲备注,也能把已有网页转成 deck。产出是可导航的 deck,不是渲染好的 MP4。
howto.when: 当你明确要求做幻灯片、演示文稿,或提到 "pitch deck" 等关键词时触发;若非明确要求,它会先暂停并确认是否要做成幻灯片。

howto.what_en: Claude builds a HyperFrames slideshow: discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching and hotspot navigation, presenter mode with speaker notes, plus page-to-deck conversion. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask for a slideshow, presentation or pitch deck; if the request is not explicit, it pauses to confirm before authoring.
